data.body: Implemented on branch story/588e-abec-221f-42c0/2730-a5e2-600b-44b3 @ ab59b68e. New admin-exemption-ledger.sh (HMAC-SHA256, reuses compute-verdict-hash.sh scheme + .closure-key, constant-time compare). Minimal additive hook in review-coverage-invariant.sh (HMAC-valid exempt SHA -> covered; forged -> still fail-closed). 8/8 behavioral tests RED->GREEN; regression 13/13.
